title: Preservation of the outer word under address lifting
statement: Let $n>0$, let $V$ be a system with Boolean input of length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and a finite random seed space, and let $K\in\mathbb N$. Suppose a reduction for $V$ supplies a three-CNF formula for each seed that is complete and sound for the verifier's local acceptance predicate. For every input word $w\colon\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to\mathrm{Bool}$, proof word $p\colon\mathrm{Fin}(\ell)\to\mathrm{Bool}$, and address in the disjoint union of input and proof addresses, the word formed using the composed proof, evaluated at the lifted address, equals the word formed using $w$ and $p$ at the original address.

natural number $K$ and a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ with parameter $K$
